newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline jumps $7-$8, piggybacks crude rally.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline jumps $7-$8, piggybacks crude rally.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices rose sharply on Monday on the back of a spring in crude oil futures, though barge traders said activity was thin heading into the end of the year.
Eurograde barges were last heard bid at $217 and offered at $218 fob ARA, against late Friday levels of $209/$211. Regular unleaded held $8-$9 lower.
Eurograde earlier traded at $215 and $215.50 and then edged higher as Jan crude oil, which expires on Monday, tacked on 61 cents and Jan gas oil catapulted $8.75, or four percent, by its close.
European gasoline demand, particularly in Germany was seen as satisfied for the time being.
But traders said they were grabbing the coattails of crude and heating oil where forecasts for colder weather in the Northeast U.S. and in parts of Northwest Europe were boosting prices.
